notes: expected_sha256=null means the operator has not yet supplied checksums: validation MUST fail with DEM files reported missing/blocked.
Supported raster types: .jp2 (GIS-ready JP2 + AUX.XML preferred), .tif/.tiff, .img (PDS FLOAT_IMG). dem_512.png and any .png are explicitly REJECTED as non-authoritative.
Place each tile (plus its AUX.XML / .LBL sidecars when available) directly in data/external/dem/ or set CH2X_DEM_DIR to a custom directory.
Do NOT commit raw DEM binaries to git; only this manifest, checksums, and derived provenance records are tracked.
